title: Level 25 - "The Quarter Hub"
physical_identity: A long-abandoned, ransacked video game arcade of echoey rooms with maroon walls, dust and wrecked 1980s-style cabinets; rare working cabinets teleport to other levels.
scale_topology: Finite indoor rooms and hallways, about 8.5 mi north-south by 9.2 mi east-west (article); notes say 8-10 miles.
anomalies: Working cabinets teleport to predetermined levels
Return cabinet always within about 100 ft
lighting_sound: Not stated for light; rooms are echoey; dripping water from pipes (notes).
items_communities: Almond Water and snacks in boilers/boxes
Notes left by the author near arrival

signature_mechanic: Quarter-operated arcade cabinets, about 1 in 1500 working, each tethered to a predetermined level with a return cabinet within about 100 ft.
conflicts_notes: Page is under rewrite. Notes (about 20 working cabinets, 8-10 mi, exits to 19/50/165/5) differ from article (1 in 1500, 8.5x9.2 mi, 20 exits). Level 10 listed as exit yet its cabinet is dead. Level 26 only in link list.
